key_decisions.ma_choice: Two-register 'output + skid' buffer. m_* is always driven from out_q, and the skid register catches the one beat accepted in the stall cycle. Chosen over a 2-entry circular FIFO.
key_decisions.plan_choice: D1: a main register drives m_axis_* and a single skid register catches the in-flight beat; 2-entry FIFO and cascade were rejected.
key_decisions.note: The spec forces 2 entries of storage. The output+skid form versus a FIFO is an architect's choice.

key_decisions.ma_choice: All outputs come straight from flops. A single 2:1 mux on the out_q D-input picks skid_q or s_payload, selected by the skid_valid_q flop.
key_decisions.plan_choice: D4/S4: outputs come directly from flop Q. One 2:1 mux sits in front of the main register and selects skid vs. input.

key_decisions.ma_choice: s_tready = !skid_valid_q, a direct inversion of a flop. It is low only while the skid register is full.
key_decisions.plan_choice: A dedicated s_tready flop with s_tready_next = !skid_valid_next.
key_decisions.note: Logically identical. The plan uses a dedicated flop instead of an inverter on skid_valid_q.

key_decisions.ma_choice: An implicit 3-state FSM (EMPTY/ONE/TWO) built from out_valid_q and skid_valid_q. Skid cannot be full while out is empty. Next-state equations are keyed on out_free.
key_decisions.plan_choice: S6: a 3-state occupancy machine (EMPTY/ONE/FULL) derived from {m_tvalid, skid_valid}, with a full transition table.

key_decisions.ma_choice: tdata/tkeep/tlast/tuser are packed into one PAY_W vector that is stored and muxed as a unit.
key_decisions.plan_choice: S3/S5: one packed payload vector, with the width formula given.

key_decisions.ma_choice: 1 cycle normally, 2 cycles for a beat that skids.
key_decisions.plan_choice: D9: 1-cycle latency; the skid register is used only on stall.

key_decisions.ma_choice: 1 beat/clk with m_tready high. No bubble when a stall releases. Exactly one s_tready-low cycle per stall episode.
key_decisions.plan_choice: S7: sustained 1 beat/clk, and throughput returns immediately after a stall releases.

key_decisions.ma_choice: USER_W parameter, default 0. A generate block removes tuser from the packing, and the ports stay present at width 1.
key_decisions.plan_choice: A USER_EN flag (default 0) plus USER_WIDTH. Storage is not generated when disabled and the output is tied to 0.
key_decisions.note: Both make tuser optional and zero-area by default. Only the parameter mechanism differs.

key_decisions.ma_choice: DATA_W defaults to 64 and must be a multiple of 8. KEEP_W = DATA_W/8 is derived.
key_decisions.plan_choice: D5: KEEP_WIDTH = DATA_WIDTH/8 as a localparam, with an elaboration check that DATA_WIDTH % 8 == 0.
key_decisions.note: The spec requires a width parameter but not the tkeep derivation.

key_decisions.ma_choice: Synchronous active-low aresetn. Only the valid flags are reset and the payload is not. s_tready = 1 during and after reset, since the skid is empty.
key_decisions.plan_choice: Synchronous active-low aresetn, with only the control flops reset and the payload not. s_tready is forced to 0 during reset and asserts the first cycle after.
key_decisions.note: Same style and scope. The plan holds s_tready low during reset, which costs one extra flop and changes the visible ready value in reset; both behaviours are AXI-legal.

key_decisions.ma_choice: m_tvalid is a flop. out_q loads only when out_free, so the payload stays stable until the handshake.
key_decisions.plan_choice: D8: strict AXI4-Stream stability, and m_tvalid is independent of m_tready.

key_decisions.ma_choice: Random valid/ready testbench with an in-order scoreboard. SVA for stability and the skid->out invariant, directed stall tests, and a formal/lint check for no comb path.
key_decisions.plan_choice: S10: randomized testbench with scoreboard, SVA, throughput check, structural/lint no-comb-path check, and width sweeps.

summary: The plan closely tracks the reference MA. It chooses the same output+skid topology with flop-driven outputs and one 2:1 mux on the output register input. It also matches on the 3-state occupancy control, packed payload, 1-cycle latency, sync active-low reset with unreset payload, single clock and an equivalent verification strategy. There are two minor, equivalent differences: tuser is gated by a USER_EN flag rather than USER_W=0, and s_tready is a separate flop held low during reset rather than !skid_valid_q, which reads 1 in reset. No questions were asked, so none are needless.
